text_block_list.text:
It happened on a day when autumn was 
deepening...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Yes, please!
choice_data_list:
How many times was the Oka Sho held at 
Kyoto?

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Did the difficulty go up from last 
week?
choice_data_list:
Well, you always guess the right answer so 
easily.
Well, you always guess it right so easily.

text_block_list.text:
In the months since deciding to become 
North Flight's rival outside of running, 
our quiz showdowns had become a regular 
habit.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly... there was a 
3-year period where it was held at Kyoto. 
Then one more time after that, so that 
makes four times—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Is what I'd have you think! It was held at 
Kyoto Racecourse last year too, so it's 5 
times!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Fufu. You still have a lot to learn, 
Trainer♪
...*inhale*...!
Flight-saaan!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Let's plaaay!

Looking down from the window, I saw Sakura 
Bakushin O shouting up at me.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: Bakushin O-chan? Play right now, you mean?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Ah! My mistake!! Let me start over! Ahem!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Please come cheer me on at this week's 
Sprinters Stakes!!

"The Sprinters Stakes is a short-distance 
GⅠ race held at Nakayama Racecourse."

Many Umamusume with an even greater focus 
on speed enter, making it the ultimate 
showdown to crown the autumn's top 
sprinter.

âFor North Flight, who seeks grand 
brilliance on the sprint path, this was a 
peak she, too, would likely challenge 
someday.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I, as class representative!! Shall 
demonstrate exemplary speed for you!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: To me...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I'm fully aware of North Flight's hidden 
speed! Because I'm the Class 
Representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
So, I shall show you the way ahead! —As 
the one who runs before you!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Well then, please shout "Bakushin!" at the 
top of your lungs on the big day! 
Bakushiiin!!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

A spark flashes in North Flight's eyes. It 
seems Sakura Bakushin O's words lit a fire 
in her.
(Waaaah...!)

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...! Such incredible energy... As expected 
of a GⅠ race.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Looks like Daitaku Helios is the crowd 
favorite! She really is the king of the 
sprint division right now.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
If it's 1,200m, it's gotta be Bakushin O, 
right? Ah, but Nishino Flower won the Oka 
Sho too! Man, I can't call it!

This year's sprint division was packed 
with star talent, and the spectators were 
bursting with excitement.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Bakushin O-chan.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Everyone is amazing, but... Bakushin 
O-chan's speed is the real deal, too.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
"I believe in Bakushin O-chan's raw 
potential."

“—Amidst thunderous cheers, the 'Sprinters 
Stakes' got underway.”

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Haahahaa!! My first GⅠ victory is mine for 
the taking――!

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
...! So fast...! Bakushin O-chan, keep on 
bakushining!!

Blasting ahead at a dazzling, eye-catching 
speed, Sakura Bakushin O is running 
strong. Just what will the outcome be...?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Everyone...! Thank you so much for your 
support...!
(Waaaaaaah...!!)

Nishino Flower... The petite "Oka Sho" 
Umamusume blew past the formidable 
competition with her razor-sharp finishing 
sprint to claim victory.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —6th place......

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: ...Beaten in speed? Me, of all people...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: —Utterly pathetic!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
For the Class Rep who should be leading 
everyone to fall behind in speed... is 
utterly out-rageous!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Bakushin upon Bakushin! Give Bakushin O 
more Bakushin...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
"I will claw my way back up, without a 
doubt! Nothing—suits me other than Class 
Rep!"

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
So this is the pinnacle of the sprint 
division...

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
Even that Bakushin O would be engulfed. 
Swallowed whole... by the pinnacle of 
speed.

North Flight was trembling. Yet, what 
dwelt in her eyes was not fear, but—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
If I could just run with everything I've 
got in there...—

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer. I'll... do my best.

text_block_list.name: North Flight
text_block_list.text:
I'll be the first to pull off that sleek, 
sharp speed...!

At Nakayama Racecourse where the seasons 
begin to turn... North Flight's sights 
were clearly set.
